report.summary: The investigation identified a spike in error rates in the api-gateway service (7.02%) during the incident window, primarily driven by connection-related failures. The root cause analysis points to connection pool exhaustion in the api-gateway, supported by direct evidence of connection resets and lost connections in logs (LOG-00565, LOG-00566, LOG-00568, LOG-00580). While auth and orders services exhibited analytics event queue issues (LOG-01040, LOG-01667, LOG-01929, LOG-01979, LOG-00371, LOG-00504, LOG-01810, LOG-01919), these were indirect and did not directly cause the connection failures. Database pool utilization in auth remained moderate (26.0% to 32.7%) and did not indicate exhaustion (MET-00011, MET-00034, MET-00057, MET-00080, MET-00103, MET-00126, MET-00149, MET-00172, MET-00195, MET-00218).
